description: This file defines the PaymentMethod class in the Opencart\Catalog\Model\Checkout namespace. The class provides functionality to retrieve available payment methods by loading extensions, checking their status, and aggregating their methods according to sort order.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Represents the payment method handler enabling fetching available payment options.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available payment methods based on current extension statuses and configurations.
